did: Built and tested together with item 17. The supplier app and the shop use the same account and the same sign-in, so a supplier signs in once. The shop's menu has a link to the supplier app for suppliers, and the supplier app has a link back to the shop.

checks.text: One account for both: the supplier app needs no second sign-in because it is part of the same site and the same session
A seller sees a way across to the supplier app in the shop's menu and footer; the supplier app has a link back to the shop
Someone who does not sell is never shown the way across, and one login serves both apps (two automatic tests)

notes: Phone and browser notifications (Web Push) were built with this: the owner only switches the card on, the site makes its own signing keys, and a person says yes once on their own device; the Messages screen has a Push tick per message. NOT verified live: a notification arriving on a real phone or browser, because this test browser blocks notifications and there is no push service reachable here; the sending was tested in 18 automatic tests with a fake sender, and the toggle's blocked state was seen on screen.
